text:
v1.0.106 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.106
NCAAB: only pregame games through tomorrow are listed, no last-season averages. Checked the log: teams were missing averages because (a) the log hadn't re-run since v1.0.105 (I just started it) and (b) blowout games (20+ point spreads) were dropped from averages, so teams like Villanova had 1 usable game of 3; those now show early averages. Teams whose games ESPN has no betting line for can't get a spread average, I can't invent one. If Bet is still missing, each card now says why (betting off vs no Novig market read yet).
Live betting slowdown: I'm investigating the connection/request load now (task LG1) and will report what I find.
